description: Java class implementing a Tree String Renderer based on Freemarker macros for rendering tree structures in OFBiz widget framework.

classes.name: MacroTreeRenderer
classes.description: Implements TreeStringRenderer to render tree structures using Freemarker macros, supporting boundary comments, node rendering, links, images, and labels.

methods.name: MacroTreeRenderer
methods.description: Constructor that loads the macro library template and initializes the Freemarker environment.

methods.name: executeMacro
methods.description: Executes a macro string within the Freemarker environment, handling errors.

methods.name: renderBeginningBoundaryComment
methods.description: Renders a beginning boundary comment for a widget, using a macro.

methods.name: renderEndingBoundaryComment
methods.description: Renders an ending boundary comment for a widget, using a macro.

methods.name: renderNodeBegin
methods.description: Renders the start of a tree node, including boundary comments and expand/collapse logic.

methods.name: renderNodeEnd
methods.description: Renders the end of a tree node, including boundary comments.

methods.name: renderLastElement
methods.description: Renders the last element in a node, typically for styling.

methods.name: renderLabel
methods.description: Renders a label for a node.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Renders a hyperlink with optional image, handling URL building.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Renders an image, constructing the URL based on mode.

methods.name: getScreenStringRenderer
methods.description: Returns a screen string renderer if available in context.
